entities.name: UniProt F4I2X9
observations: Exact 534-aa sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana probable alkaline/neutral invertase D (UniProt F4I2X9).
Annotated catalytic activity: invertase, EC 3.2.1.26; cleaves sucrose into glucose and fructose.

entities.name: Sucrose hydrolysis
observations: Invertase reaction: sucrose + H2O → D-glucose + D-fructose (EC 3.2.1.26).

Specific substrate/product annotation is supported by exact sequence identity to reviewed UniProt F4I2X9; general EC wording describes hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing beta-D-fructofuranoside residues.
